new_relations.title: Height is tested by downward service
new_relations.project_anchor: The project evaluates authority by protection, repair and service rather than domination alone.
new_relations.biblical_structure: Jesus contrasts domination with service and models service through washing disciples' feet
new_relations.source_direction: Project service ethic first; Gospel comparison later.
new_relations.mismatch: These passages teach discipleship ethics and do not establish a modern person's rank.

relation_argument.maximum_claim: They provide a strong ethical comparator in which authority is tested by service.
